text:
Michelle: Heads up — trying to sketch a "compact audit view" for Console. Goal: default to minimal rows (actor, action, time) and let users sideload full event details on demand. Thoughts on perf + export implications?

Ajay: Sounds good. How do we handle exports? If default is compact, exported NDJSON should still be able to include full payloads — otherwise auditors will complain. :thinking_face:

Sam: Agree with Ajay but full payloads can blow up for large windows. Suggest export mode enum: compact | full | sampled. compact mirrors UI; full is raw event; sampled allows e.g. 1/1000 or 1/10k sampling depending on org size.

Zara: Sampling is tricky for compliance — auditors expect exhaustive trails. Sampled exports must be opt-in with an explicit warning and documented limitations. :warning:

Michelle: Proposal: UI default = "Compact" for browsing. Export dialog has radio options: compact / full / streamed-ndjson / sampled. For full we show estimated size + a checkbox "Include PII fields" that requires an extra confirmation. Sketch of export payload:

```
{
  "export_mode": "full",
  "include_pii": false,
  "time_range": "2026-02-01T00:00:00Z/2026-02-28T23:59:59Z",
  "sampling_rate": null
}
```

Ajay: API-first preference: GET /v1/audit/exports?mode=full&pii=0&stream=true. Streaming endpoint should emit ndjson and support a resume token header so big exports can be resumed if connection drops.

Sam: Also need server-side throttles and an async job model with signed URL for download. Plus a retention/authorization check: deny full export if org retention policy is shorter than requested range (or at least block + explain).

compliance-bot: Auto-note: exports containing PII require 2FA + export-audit-recording. Flagging this thread for Security review.

Zara: For the in-console expand-on-demand UX, rather than fetching the entire event blob, fetch an "event_delta" payload that contains only changed keys + small before/after snippets. That keeps the compact stream efficient. Example delta:

```
{"delta": {"quota": ["1000","2000"], "route_policy": ["deny","allow-with-override"]}}
```

Michelle: Nice. Next steps: I'll update the mockups and API doc. @Ajay can you draft a short API proto by EOD? @Zara can you write a short note on sampling vs compliance tradeoffs for Legal/Security? We'll sync in tomorrow's eng-platform async channel. :thumbsup:
